comments: I|g values from 2007ChZX were normalized by the factor |s{-|g}(873)/I|g(873)=0.168/0.068 to obtain elemental partial cross sections, |s{-|g}, where the absolute partial cross section |s{-|g}(873)=0.168 b was determined by 2003Re38. The data from 1967We04 and 1974Co21 were normalized by the factors 0.02203 and 0.07109, respectively, to match the 2007ChZX |s{-|g} values; the normalization factors were determined from the average ratios of intensities, compared to 2007ChZX, for the 16 most intense primary |g's observed in all three works. The |s{-|g} values were then converted to intensity per 100 n captures by multiplying |s{-|g} by 100/f|s{-0}, where f=0.29524 is the isotopic abundance and |s{-0}=12.5 b 6 is the total capture cross section (1970Si10). To obtain |s{-|g} (in barns), multiply value quoted for I|g by f|s/100=0.0369.
